sentences: Duolingo's shares moved 5% or more on 43 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 28 September 2026, when the stock fell 6.4%.
The stock is down 27.1% this year, and at $128.00 it sits 51.7% below its 52-week closing high of $264.93 from 3 November 2025.
$1,000 invested in Duolingo five years ago would be worth $757 today.
